::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 139,703 people lived in County Louth, up 8.4% on 2016. It had the 12th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 109% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Louth was €1,433, the 8th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Louth

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Louth was €30,542, the 7th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Louth was €348,700, the 8th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 11.0 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Louth, the highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 29% of households in County Louth rented their home, the 6th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 22% of people living in County Louth were born outside Ireland, the 4th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 35% of people aged 3 and over in County Louth said they could speak Irish, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 30% of people at work in County Louth worked from home for at least part of the week, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 71% of people travelling to work in County Louth went by car, the second lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Louth live more than 1.5 km by road from a GP, the 21st furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Louth live more than 24.6 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 12th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 4.2% of County Louth in 2021, the third lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
